project.title: AstraBuild: GPT-6 Astra as a Long-Horizon 3D Engineering Agent for Component-Level Substation Reconstruction

authority_sources.path_or_reference: release/behavior_analysis.json (from scripts/analyze_process_behavior.py over read-only historical batch folders)

contract.gap: Registered photogrammetric geometry and field imagery do not directly provide the editable component hierarchy, reusable asset structure, site-specific connections, persistent revision history, or inspection-addressable semantics required by the target engineering digital twin.
contract.task: Characterize how one GPT-6 Astra/Codex engineering workflow reconstructs heterogeneous substation equipment and infrastructure within one persistent Blender/Python state, and document how task-level outputs accumulate into a component-level station model.

questions.text: Can one general-purpose reasoning agent operate across heterogeneous component-level 3D reconstruction tasks and compose the resulting assets into a persistent industrial digital twin?

contract.contribution: A longitudinal, evidence-grounded case study of a general-purpose reasoning model operating a persistent 3D engineering workflow across heterogeneous reconstruction tasks, with auditable intermediate artifacts, revision histories, and station-scale integration.
nonclaims: not proof that internal model chain-of-thought is recoverable from historical artifacts

semantic_locks.canonical: longitudinal single-site case study; later batches inherit earlier engineering state
D38.2 is the core geometry baseline; D40 is presentation-only and geometry-invariant; D41 is the additive inspection-semantic endpoint
reference-surface residuals are against the same photogrammetric mesh used during reconstruction and are not independent survey accuracy
human feedback materially affects B08, B36, D38 and semantic audit decisions; the workflow is human-steerable rather than fully autonomous
Codex + GPT-6 Astra Extra High is owner-confirmed experimental metadata; old batch manifests do not independently freeze the model configuration

terminology.preferred: editable component-level station model / digital twin

style_profile.language_variant: English research prose with Chinese parallel translation on website

facts.value: 79 accessory meshes; 17 selected inspection-relevant classes on T1 and T2

alignment.method: Persistent Blender/Python reconstruction workflow using registered coarse geometry, field imagery, engineering records, prior batch state, deterministic execution, task-specific validation, and preserved review/revision artifacts.
alignment.evidence: 38 core batches; 12 task families; 32 original review pages; process dossiers; task-native validation ledgers; representative preserved failures and revisions; station integration artifacts.
alignment.result: The workflow produced heterogeneous editable task outputs that were retained, revised, reused, connected, and integrated into a 37,153-object station model, followed by D41 inspection-semantic augmentation.
alignment.interpretation: Within this single-site longitudinal case, one general-purpose reasoning-agent workflow operated across heterogeneous 3D engineering tasks while maintaining persistent external engineering state.
alignment.limitation: No matched model comparison, independent survey truth, or cross-site replication; human feedback materially affected several trajectories; model metadata are owner-confirmed rather than independently recoverable from legacy logs.
alignment.contribution: Documents the task breadth, observable revision behavior, process evidence, and system-level composition of a persistent 3D engineering agent workflow.

decisions.decision: Website should read as an interactive technical report, not a product landing page or benchmark dashboard.
Original batch review.html pages are primary task-level qualitative evidence.
Kimi/specialist 3D baselines are out of scope for the current advisor-discussion draft.
Website prose follows the project-scoped academic-writing-skills review contract; the final website prose candidate passed stock-prose and text-consistency audits on 2026-09-16.

v0.8 reframes paper and website from outcome presentation to behavioral analysis of the agent under test, modeled on the robodojo gpt-6-astra-eval report style: model/harness decoupling, E1-E3 occupancy taxonomy, findings-first structure, negative results front-loaded. Paper lands as new file paper_v08_analysis.md (v0.7 retained as REFERENCE); website rewritten in place; tex sync deferred until venue decision.

issues.description: No independent survey/LiDAR truth; geometric residuals use correlated photogrammetric reference. This is retained as an explicit validity limitation and claim boundary.
Single-site longitudinal case does not establish cross-site generalization. This is retained as an explicit scope limitation.
Legacy batch records do not independently freeze model/reasoning-effort metadata; the current manuscript labels the configuration as owner-confirmed metadata.
